english.title: Aid / abet the production of a controlled drug - Class B - Other
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled or procured another, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to produce

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY QUANTITY..)]_
(B)_[a quantity]_

of **(..SPECIFY DRUG NOT LISTED IN NOTE (ii) BELOW..), a controlled drug of class B in contravention of section 4(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(2)(a) of and Schedule 4 to the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 and section 8 of the Accessories and Abettors Act 1861.

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required

english.notes:
(i) Di -hydrocodeine is a class b drug when in injection form , when in tablet form it is a prescription controlled drug under the Medicines Act 1968 and not deemed a classified drug for the purposes of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
(ii) This offence wording should only be used for class 'B' drugs NOT specified in the following list: H2375 - amphetamine.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Fourteen years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
